LanguageData.RavenTrap_Gas_Anesthetic.label: (Raven) Anesthetic Gas Trap
LanguageData.RavenTrap_Gas_Anesthetic.description: Releases a cloud of anesthetic gas when triggered, causing those who inhale it to fall unconscious.
LanguageData.RavenTrap_Gas_Aphrodisiac.label: (Raven) Aphrodisiac Gas Trap
LanguageData.RavenTrap_Gas_Aphrodisiac.description: Releases a cloud of powerful aphrodisiac gas when triggered. Victims will involuntarily fall into a state of intense excitement and exhaustion, eventually collapsing.
